name: Anrubic
description: Powerful hero that can grapple enemies and merge with other Xol units to augment its abilities.

abilities.name: Merge
abilities.description:
Merge with a first tier Xol unit, gaining an ability and stats based on the unit type, healing {heal}% of the unit's health, and Overclocks the Xol hero for {overclock} seconds.
When targeting an enemy unit, deal damage and heal for {damage}+{damage_percent}% of the target's health.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.description: Pulls to the target, rooting it and dealing {damage} damage to the target and any units on the way.
